name: decay
description: Calculates a relevance score that decays based on the distance of a numeric, spatial or date type value from a target origin, using configurable decay functions.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to score. A `null` value scores `null`, and a multivalued value scores `null` with a warning.

params.name: origin
params.description: Central point from which the distances are calculated. Must be a constant.

params.name: scale
params.description: Distance beyond `offset` at which the score equals `decay`. Must be a constant greater than 0.

params.name: options
params.mapParams: {name='offset', values=[], description='Distance from the origin within which the score is 1. Must not be negative. Defaults to 0.', type=[double, integer, long, unsigned_long, time_duration, date_period, keyword, text]}, {name='decay', values=[], description='Score at `scale` beyond `offset`. Must be greater than 0 and less than 1. Defaults to 0.5.', type=[double]}, {name='type', values=[], description='Decay function to use: `linear`, `exp`, or `gauss`. Defaults to `linear`.', type=[keyword]}
params.description: (Optional) Additional options such as `decay`, `offset` and `type`.

examples:
FROM employees
| EVAL decay_result = decay(salary, 0, 100000, {"offset": 5, "decay": 0.5, "type": "linear"})
| SORT decay_result DESC

FROM books METADATA _score
| WHERE MATCH(author, "Faulkner")
| EVAL boosted = _score * COALESCE(DECAY(year, 2005, 1, {"type": "exp", "decay": 0.25}), 0.5)
| SORT boosted DESC
| KEEP book_no, author, year
| LIMIT 2
